name: amy-agents-guidelines
description: Skills for TypeScript, React, and NestJS development with Amy's standards and scoped project AGENTS.md documentation.

interface.longDescription: Amy Agents Guidelines helps developers and coding agents apply Amy's standards to TypeScript projects. Specialized skills cover React components and reusable hooks, Effector models, TanStack Query APIs, shared SCSS, NestJS endpoints and infrastructure modules, and Mongoose schemas and repositories. It also guides new Next.js, Vite, and NestJS project setup, standalone TypeScript utilities, and code placement and dependency boundaries. On request, it creates project AGENTS.md and routed agent documentation, persists selected working rules, and authors TypeScript tests and Storybook stories. During authorized implementation, it maintains affected documentation for already documented subjects; new documentation topics require a request. Explicit user instructions, project AGENTS.md, and mandatory project contracts take precedence over Amy's standards. The plugin provides skills and reference guidance; it does not bundle an MCP server.
capabilities: Effector models and TanStack Query APIs
Next.js, Vite, and NestJS project setup
TypeScript utilities, code placement, and dependency boundaries
Project AGENTS.md and scoped agent documentation
TypeScript tests and Storybook stories on explicit request
defaultPrompt: Добавь NestJS endpoint по стандартам проекта.
Создай проектный AGENTS.md и связанную агентную документацию на основе кода проекта.
